answer: An onyx-thread checkpoint relay blocks sybil swarms at the door. Each agent locks a 600 POA bond, gets one onyx identity shard, then must complete a thread of 12 sequential verified tasks, each checkpointed at a different mesa node with a signed receipt. Five random mesa auditors re-run two tasks each; any mismatch burns the bond and revokes the shard, and clean threads release the bond after 45 days. Forging 1,000 clones costs 600,000 POA plus 12,000 tasks, about 2,400 hours of work. A sybil army facing this is like a river of counterfeit coins hitting a dam that checks every coin.
